findings.title: Avoid interpolating expanded targets again in subrequests
findings.body: This expands template variables before splitting, but the subrequests still go through datasource.runQuery and the normal backend-query path, which calls applyTemplateVariables again with the same scoped variables. Shard requests are additionally expanded at their entry point. Template replacement is not idempotent: for a query containing `|= "$pattern"`, a pattern value of `error $code` is expanded again if `code` is another dashboard variable, changing the literal filter and therefore the results. Ordinary split queries previously interpolated only in the execution path. Ensure expanded subrequests bypass subsequent interpolation; the new tests mock runQuery and therefore miss this regression.
